rate.unit: percent of statutory net accommodation-service consideration
rate.source_name: Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı — Law 6802, article 34, annotated with Presidential Decision 11263
rate.note: National accommodation tax, not an Istanbul municipal levy. Article 34's temporary rate annotation applies through 2026-12-31. The base excludes VAT but includes accommodation and services sold together with it at the establishment; The distinct basis percent_of_accommodation_services_net preserves those bundled services. Separately shown accommodation tax is not part of the VAT base. Legal text read directly in the official browser page; corroborating GİB notice: https://cdn.gib.gov.tr/api/gibportal-file/file/getFile?objectKey=DUYURU%2FUNIVERSAL%2F2026%2FCK11263_not.pdf.

periods.exemptions: Article 34 exempts services provided to students in student dormitories, boarding houses and camps; reciprocal qualifying foreign diplomatic/consular missions and their privileged members; and treaty-exempt international organisations and members. No general leisure/business or child exemption was verified.

assessment_base.includes: Accommodation plus services sold together at the establishment.
assessment_base.excludes: VAT; separately identified accommodation tax is not itself in the VAT base.

unresolved: Research only. This file is not the production cost schema and must never be read by the application. A future transform must reject unconfirmed/disputed records and preserve product, date, endpoint, visitor eligibility and purchase-channel conditions even for confirmed records.

Eating-out records are named menu observations, not city averages or daily budgets. No official citywide midrange classification was established. Published two-person dishes/packages are recorded directly without doubling individual prices; their inclusions matter.

The five attractions are a research selection, not a verified popularity ranking. Published tariffs do not assert availability on the collection date or a future travel date. Booking-policy evidence is retained in entry_price.note because the agreed boolean has no envelope.

accommodation_charges contains verified non-tax accommodation charges. An empty array means no such charge was verified in this research; it is not proof that every property has no service, resort or other fee. Property-specific charges require property-level evidence.

The temporary national accommodation-tax reduction expires at the end of 2026. Do not carry its rate into 2027 without rechecking the law. The new percent_of_accommodation_services_net basis records the bundled-services base explicitly; the transform must implement that exact basis.
Foreign-visitor TRY prices remain unconfirmed for Hagia Sophia's upper gallery and Galata Tower. The own-currency requirement was preserved without conversion or use of resident concessions.

research-v3 removes overall journey_minutes, attraction durations and taxi fare ranges. journey_legs contains only identifiable operator-published legs; interchange/walking assumptions belong to a later model. taxi_tariffs is an array of named applicability categories, each with base_fare, per_km, per_waiting_minute and airport_surcharge envelopes; distance/time/vehicle bands must remain separate. Transit envelopes add validity_area. No app or production cost schema consumes these files.

Airport scope remains IST and SAW from the repository configuration, without independently verifying live origin schedules. SAW now has an ordinary M4 boarding price and a published rail-leg time to Kadıköy; the European-side destination remains an additional journey, not silently included.

The IST M11 fare and City Card day-pass price remain critical unresolved inputs despite a targeted second pass. Official tariff locations were identified but their required content could not be read. The failure and entry-debit/refund distinction are recorded at the affected envelopes. They must be rejected by any transform; no ordinary metro fare, historical amount, reseller amount or inferred price is a substitute.

The current official taxi PDF and consolidated tariff were inaccessible. An indexed older tariff is not a current rate. Airport surcharges and fixed-transfer products remain unconfirmed rather than zero or not_offered.
Booking-policy booleans remain unknown where no explicit applicable rule was verified. Removed visit-duration fields are intentionally outside this cost research.

research-v4 adds the closed tax basis registry and calculation metadata. Conditional means the recorded formula supports only its named case with all required inputs; it does not mean a guest total is ready. Unknown basis, unsupported assessment, missing inputs and unresolved evidence must cause explicit refusal, never an average, nearest-shape mapping or zero.

Conditional reframing: this tax depends structurally on the accommodation model. The registry proposes a derived tax component with the stay estimate’s provenance and an explicit incomplete-total state whenever a required charge cannot be represented. No actual room quote is expected from city research; no production calculator or result-card change is made here.

2026-11-02 owner decision supersedes the earlier model-derived tax proposal: statutory accommodation tax is inside the traveller-payable allowance and must never be added again. Exact legal research remains for plausibility/inclusion checks and future provider reconciliation; no tax transform is implemented.
